events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Three counties I've had his partner's sign. He's yours to push out of the brush and mine to finish. Don't lose him for me in there.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Driven off, not killed, and I wasn't alone doing it. Hiram Cobb rode nine years at my shoulder and never once gave me that.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Straight pay, and a straight answer about what happens on a bad night. Deacon Marsh never gave me either one. I'll take the watch.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: I've had a lot of backs go bad on me. Yours hasn't. I figure I'm allowed to say that out loud the once.
